sources.title: xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google publishes compressed-tensors W4A16 QAT checkpoints for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B. Its QAT model card lists none for 26B-A4B, which ships as Q4_0 GGUF and as a 48 GiB bf16 export.

sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: gemma4:e4b-it-qat
sources.snippet: Readme Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input and generating text output. Gemma 4 introduces key capability and architectural advancements: Reasoning - All models in the family are designed as highly capable reasoners, with configurable thinking modes.

sources.title: Gemma 4 with quantization-aware training - The Keyword
sources.snippet: By simulating quantization during training, QAT minimizes quality loss when the model is compressed. This release includes QAT checkpoints for the popular Q4_0 quantization format as well as a novel quantization format specialized for mobile use cases. Using this mobile format, we've reduced the memory footprint of Gemma 4 E2B to 1GB.
